chapter.li: LEChapter4 Verse1 Now I’ll write about the prophecies my father has spoken of concerning Joseph, who was taken into Egypt. Verse12 After my father had spoken to his whole household according to the feelings of his heart and the Spirit of the Lord in him, his health failed and he died and was buried. VerseEnd

Verse13 Not many days after his death, Laman, Lemuel, and Ishmael’s sons were angry with me because of the Lord’s warnings and correction VerseEnd Verse14 that I was inspired to tell them based on His word. I taught them many things, as my father did before he died. Much of what was said is written on my other plates, since more historical details are written on them. VerseEnd Verse15 But on these plates I only write the things within my soul and quotes of the scriptures from the brass plates. My soul delights in the scriptures, and I ponder upon them and write them for my children’s instruction and benefit. VerseEnd Verse16 My soul rejoices in the things of the Lord, and I continually ponder in my heart what God has shown and told me. VerseEnd

Verse17 Nevertheless — despite the Lord’s great goodness in showing me His great and awe-inspiring works — my heart cries out: How wretched a man am I! Indeed, my heart mourns because of my human weakness. My soul is pained because of my shortcomings. VerseEnd Verse18 I’m surrounded on all sides because of the temptations and sins that so easily trap me. VerseEnd Verse19 When I want to be glad, I mourn over my sins. Nevertheless, I know whom I’ve trusted. VerseEnd Verse20 God has supported me. He’s led me through my troubles in the wilderness and preserved me while crossing the deep waters. VerseEnd Verse21 He’s filled me with so much of His love that it has completely overwhelmed me. VerseEnd Verse22 He’s defeated my enemies, making them shake in front of me. VerseEnd Verse23 He’s heard my prayer by day and given me knowledge by visions at night. VerseEnd Verse24 I’ve grown bold through powerful prayers offered to Him by day. I’ve sent up my voice to heaven, and angels have come down and taught me. VerseEnd Verse25 My body has been carried away on the wings of His Spirit upon very high mountains; and my eyes have seen great things — too great for man — and I was ordered not to write them. VerseEnd

Verse26 Then, if I’ve seen such great things, if the Lord — who descends from His high position to help mankind — if He has visited me with so much mercy, then why does my heart weep and my soul linger in the valley of sorrow, why does my body cower and my strength fail me because of my difficulties? VerseEnd Verse27 Why should I ever submit to temptations because of weaknesses? Why should I let any temptation by the Evil One have a place in my heart to cause me regret and trouble my soul? Why am I angry with myself because of my enemy? VerseEnd Verse28 Wake up, my soul! Don’t focus on sin any longer! Rejoice, my heart; don’t give any attention to the enemy of my soul anymore. VerseEnd Verse29 Don’t get angry because of my enemies. Don’t lose resolve to obey God because I face troubles. VerseEnd Verse31 O Lord, redeem my soul! Rescue me from my enemies! Make me shudder when sin appears!
